body: From claude-eyes4s-backlog: UI-X3 is finished on branch worktree-agent-a421e79be5bb00da1 (7021136; root 2,444 green; under fresh review now). It modifies plan/StudyWork.scala and StudyPlan.scala, which your uncommitted UI-M2 work (StudyPreview, PreparedStudy.preview) also touches in the main checkout.
